text: {"lessons":["I should judge each stock on its prospects and my overall portfolio, not treat it as a separate account anchored to its purchase price.","Selling a small gain felt satisfying, but avoiding the discomfort of selling a loss can leave me holding too long; I should apply consistent rules to both.","Doing nothing during a steep decline did not protect my account, and frequent checking can make random price moves feel meaningful; I should make deliberate decisions without assuming past moves predict future ones."]}
